notes.title: 🔔 New Playable Characters Join the ANTHEM#9 Online Demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3][b]We’re excited to announce that ANTHEM#9 will be participating in Steam Next Fest, running from Monday, October 13 to Monday, October 20, 2025![/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750308/bd0eab09bcc93c0661626a4ae33535586b7b2ed5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This time, the playable demo will include two brand-new characters:[/p][p]🎲 [b]Phannie – A hedonistic gambler who lives for risky plays[/b][/p][p]🛡️ [b]Beni – A self-proclaimed hero of justice with unwavering resolve[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Together with the returning protagonist [b]Rubit[/b], [u]players can now choose between three unique characters[/u], each offering their own skills, strategies, and playstyles.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo includes the first dungeon segment for each character — giving you a taste of how each one handles in battle. Compared to our previous offline demos, this version is slightly more accessible, designed to let you explore the systems at your own pace.[/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to pay attention to how each character’s abilities and playstyle completely change the way you approach combat. Whether you're stacking poison, gambling on high-risk combos, or buffing yourself into an unbreakable tank — there's a style for every strategist.[/p][p][/p][p]💠 Early Access via Discord[/p][p][/p][p]Players who join our official Discord server by Wednesday, October 2 will receive early access to the online demo before it's publicly released![/p][p][/p][p]👉 Join here: [url="https://discord.gg/Ap3JGdmECq"]https://discord.gg/Ap3JGdmECq[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]📅 Key Dates[/p][p][/p][p]Steam Next Fest Participation:[/p][p]🗓️ October 13 (Mon) – October 20 (Mon), 2025[/p][p][/p][p]Online Demo Public Period:[/p][p]🗓️ October 10 (Fri) – October 31 (Fri), 2025
(Dates may be subject to change)[/p][p][/p][p]Early Access for Discord Members:[/p][p]🗓️ October 2 (Wed), 2025[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 We’re heading to Tokyo Game Show 2025! 🚨
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to share that our game will be playable at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b], taking place from September 25–28, 2025![/p][p][i](The demo will be the same version previously shown at BitSummit the 13th.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This time, we’re bringing along brand-new event goodies, so if you haven’t had the chance to play yet, we’d love for you to stop by our booth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Booth Challenge — Win an Exclusive T-Shirt![/b][/p][list][*][p]Play on Expert Mode (Normal or higher)[/p][/*][*][p]Clear the stage with a 30+ combo[/p][/*][*][p]Complete the challenge to receive an original event T-shirt![/p][/*][/list][p][i]Please note: novelty items are available only while supplies last. T-shirts are limited to the first 5 winners each day.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to meet you at TGS—come by, try the game, and show us what you’ve got![/p][p][/p][p]For everyone who can’t make it to the event:[/p][p]👉 Add the game to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] to stay updated on release news.[/p][p]👉 Join our [b]official Discord[/b] to connect with the community, share your runs, and get the latest announcements first.

🎮 Join the server here: [url="https://discord.gg/Ap3JGdmECq"]https://discord.gg/Ap3JGdmECq[/url][/p]

notes.title: [Event Announcement] Revamped Demo at BitSummit the 13th + Discord Launch Event!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750308/9f2b0a14a01bb5824b5d5653e6d0a8dfb99cf751.png"][/img][/p][p][b]We’re excited to announce that ANTHEM#9 will be exhibiting at BitSummit the 13th: Summer of Yokai, taking place from July 18 (Fri) to July 20 (Sun), 2025![/b][/p][p][url="https://bitsummit.org/"]https://bitsummit.org/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]At the event, we’ll be showcasing a brand-new demo featuring two playable modes:[/p][p][/p][p]Beginner Mode – Learn the basic flow of the game and discover the secret to landing massive and satisfying combos.[/p][p][/p][p]Expert Mode – Choose from Easy, Normal, or Hard difficulty, build your deck, and tackle a full dungeon in a challenging, rewarding experience![/p][p][/p][p][b]That’s not all—we’ve also launched the official ANTHEM#9 Discord server![/b][/p][p]🎮 Join the server here: [url="https://discord.gg/Ap3JGdmECq"]https://discord.gg/Ap3JGdmECq[/url][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’re running a special demo key giveaway:[/p][p]Anyone who joins the Discord between July 9 (Tue) and July 20 (Sun) will get exclusive access to the online demo that is available at Bitsummit. The keys will be sent from July 31![/p][p][/p][p]More details will be shared on the server, so come hang out, chat with the team, and be part of the growing community![/p][p][/p][p]Campaign Period[/p][p]Active from 7/9 (Tues) ~ 7/20 (Fri)[/p]

notes.title: [Event Announcement] ANTHEM#9 will be exhibited at TIGS2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750308/503c2ecedcb236db6bf42678e3ac01fd102c8b56.png[/img]
We will be exhibiting at "TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025"! 
We're waiting for you on March 8 (Sat) and March 9 (Sun) at Musashino Public Hall 2F Conference Room 1-2! 
*For details, please visit https://indiegamessummit.tokyo

In the event demo, we've updated the 3D models, added new enemies, and new visual effects.
Come experience the exhilarating battles with massive combos unleashed by the newly reborn protagonist!

Additionally, we've released a "3D Update Trailer", so please check it out!
